## Multiplatform Inquisition
- ARM64/Quest/Android: `FoveatedRenderTelemetryEntry` is `[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 1, Size = 64)]`; the heartbeat buffer is vault-owned and 64-byte arena aligned by `GlobalDataVault`; Quest 2/Oculus Quest fixed-high FFR detection is cached only after conclusive XR identity, does not depend on Vulkan, records pending identity in telemetry, and excludes Quest 3/Quest Pro.
- Metal/Mac: no shader, compute kernel, thread group, or DirectX-only path was introduced in `Graphics/VR`; PC/Mac standalone-like VR only uses Unity XR foveation flags when hardware caps and gaze data exist.
- Steam Deck: normal runtime performs no disk reads and no per-frame file writes; blackbox dump is one-shot only on non-finite/crash path and does not retry every frame if storage is unavailable.
- PC God-Mode: PC VR is not clamped to mobile fixed FFR; High/Ultra no-pressure VR without gaze clears fixed foveation, while valid eye fixation uses gaze-allowed VRS with a 0.75-second provider-sample grace and reports hardware foveation state into existing XR shader globals for downstream visual overkill; the old Quest-only enforcer can no longer overwrite the PC/Quest 3 path.
